Meet Pho Yummy

A taste of Vietnam in Lebanon

Pho Yummy

Pho Yummy is a Vietnamese restaurant located on Quentin Road in Lebanon, PA. The restaurant is known for its large portions, fragrant pho broth (including Shrimp Pho and Brisket Pho), fresh spring rolls, and moderate prices. Takeout is available, making it easy to enjoy the authentic flavors at home.

Reviews consistently praise the quality of the food and the overall dining experience. Whether you're looking for a quick bite or a full meal, Pho Yummy offers a taste of Vietnam in a welcoming atmosphere.

Takeout offered

Takeout is available. You can place your order by calling Pho Yummy directly.
